title: Hideo Kojima Back in the Cyberpunk Universe for Edgerunners Season 2
summary:
Kojima's character makes a cameo appearance.

Having appeared as Hideyoshi Oshima in a Cyberpunk 2077 quest (if you searched hard enough), Metal Gear Solid and Death Stranding creator Hideo Kojima will return to the Cyberpunk 2077 universe for a cameo appearance in the anime TV show Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.

Season two debuts on Netflix tomorrow, 20th October 2026, and the series' official social media channels have revealed a Kojima cameo will be included in the new set of episodes. With the game split across five different eras (1915, 1929, 1943, 1951, and 1965), this trailer explores act one, set in Kokura during 1915. Round two soon?
